_source: Ghostty.sdef (1.4.0) + the macOS app's SessionLocationLauncher.swift / SessionTerminalAdapter.swift. NOT executed.
focus_by_tty:
with timeout of 15 seconds
tell application id "com.mitchellh.ghostty"
set candidates to every terminal whose tty is "/dev/ttys004"
if (count of candidates) is not 1 then error "Original pane unavailable"
focus (item 1 of candidates)
if tty of focused terminal of selected tab of front window is not "/dev/ttys004" then error "Pane selection was not confirmed"
return "focused"
end tell
end timeout
new_window_running_command:
with timeout of 15 seconds
tell application id "com.mitchellh.ghostty"
set config to new surface configuration
set initial working directory of config to "/Users/example/project"
set command of config to "exec /bin/zsh -lic 'cd -- /Users/example/project && exec codex resume 01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002'"
new window with configuration config
activate
return "dispatched"
end tell
end timeout
